concerns.text: FR‑010, FR‑034, FR‑035 require a JSON‑Line `pipeline.log` that records seed, command‑line, software versions and conforms to `pipeline_log.schema.yaml`. No task creates, writes, or validates such a log file.

FR‑009 mandates a Makefile with targets `all`, `evaluate`, `enrich`, `summary`, and `clean`. The task list does not include any task that creates or populates this Makefile, leaving the required orchestration undefined.

FR‑017 specifies a verification script that runs after each Make target to confirm presence and parsability of all required outputs. No task implements this verification script or its integration into the pipeline.
SC‑002 demands that each species’ GO enrichment report contain at least one term with adjusted p‑value < 0.05. There is no verification task or CI check ensuring this condition is met.

Constitution Principle III requires checksums for *all* files under `data/`. Tasks only record checksums for raw GEO downloads (T005) and omit checksum generation for derived artifacts (processed matrices, mapping tables, etc.), violating data‑hygiene requirements.

SC‑001 applies AUROC ≥ 0.70 and AUPRC ≥ 0.70 only to species that have at least one predicted edge. CI task T019 unconditionally asserts these thresholds for every species, which conflicts with the specification and may cause spurious failures.
